senses.gloss: pr. n. (v. preced.) Ha-Tsofim (Outlook, Scopos), an eminence north of Jerusalem.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:13">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הרואה את ירושלם מן הצ׳ וכ׳</he> he who sees Jerusalem (after its destruction) from the Scopos, must rend his garments.
